description: Create a spend mandate for an agent: per-payment cap, period cap, currencies, corridors, rails (bank, provider, stablecoin_wallet), optional cap on cost above the official rate, the person who approves, and an expiry. A router key is required. A person still approves every payment. The mandate does not send money.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

agent_id.description: Your own id for the agent this mandate covers, e.g. 'ap-agent-1'.

approver_person_id.description: The person who approves. An agent cannot approve alone.

currencies_allowed.description: ISO 4217 codes the agent may pay in, e.g. ['ZAR', 'USD'].

max_cost_above_official_pct.description: Optional. Most a payment may cost above the official rate, in percent (e.g. 1.5); null for no cap.

period.description: The window max_per_period applies to: day, week or month.

rails_allowed.description: Rails the agent may use: bank, provider, stablecoin_wallet.

name: create_mandate
title: Create a per-agent spend mandate
